spice.model: .model AOD442 NMOS(LEVEL=1 VTO=2.1 KP=58 RD=0.0178 IS=1.7e-12)

sources: AOS AOD442/AOI442 data sheet Rev 0 (Aug 2009) – LCSC product data of C87617, https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/011223d17b106d635827f4167d138bd1.pdf?productCode=C87617, read 2026-11-03 (edakit part fetch): p. 1 product summary, TO252 top view, absolute maximum ratings and thermal characteristics; p. 2 electrical characteristics
vds_max_v 60, vgs_max_v ±20: p. 1 absolute maximum ratings

id_max_a 7 and p_max_w 2.1: IDSM and PDSM at TA = 25 °C, the simulation's ambient (5 A and 1.3 W at 70 °C; 37 A and 60 W at TC = 25 °C on a heat sink) – the board has no heat sink; the junction temperature is LIM.t's, from rth_ja_k_per_w
rth_ja_k_per_w 60: p. 1 RθJA steady state max (typ 51; 1 in² FR-4, 2 oz copper, note A); tj_max_c 150: note A, PDSM is based on TJ 150 °C (the absolute maximum TJ is 175 °C)
vgs_th_v 1.6 / 2.1 / 2.7 V; rds_on_max_ohm 25 mΩ at VGS 4.5 V and 20 mΩ at 10 V (ID 20 A, TJ 25 °C; 37 mΩ at 10 V and TJ 125 °C): p. 2 static parameters
vsd_v_at_1a 0.7: p. 2 VSD typ at IS = 1 A (max 1 V); is_body_max_a 32: p. 2 IS
pins 1 G, 2 D (the tab), 3 S: EasyEDA symbol of C87617 (edakit part import) and the TO252 drawing of p. 1
spice: assumption – level 1 fitted by Claude: VTO = VGS(th) typ, KP and RD so that RDS(on) meets 25 mΩ at 4.5 V and 20 mΩ at 10 V; IS from VSD 0.7 V at 1 A
notes: N-channel MOSFET in ADLSC's ground return: the low-side reverse-polarity protection.

checked: p. 1: VDS 60 V, VGS ±20 V, IDSM 7 / 5 A and PDSM 2.1 / 1.3 W at TA 25 / 70 °C, RθJA 51 / 60 K/W
p. 2: VGS(th) 1.6 / 2.1 / 2.7 V, RDS(on) 20 / 25 mΩ max at 10 / 4.5 V, VSD 0.7 V typ at 1 A
open: SPICE model is a level-1 fit, not AOS's model
